title: SAT Mini Practice Test 1 (Original)
description: 10 original practice questions across Math and Reading/Writing.

questions.prompt: Solve for x: 3(x − 2) = 15
questions.explanation: Distribute: 3x − 6 = 15. Add 6 to both sides: 3x = 21. Divide by 3: x = 7.

questions.prompt: If 2a + b = 11 and a − b = 1, what is the value of a?
questions.explanation: From a − b = 1, get b = a − 1. Substitute: 2a + (a − 1) = 11 ⇒ 3a − 1 = 11 ⇒ 3a = 12 ⇒ a = 4.

questions.prompt: A right triangle has legs of length 6 and 8. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: Use the Pythagorean theorem: c = √(6² + 8²) = √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10.

questions.prompt: A jacket’s price increases from $80 to $92. What is the percent increase?
questions.explanation: Increase = 92 − 80 = 12. Percent increase = 12/80 = 0.15 = 15%.

questions.prompt: For the function f(x) = 2x + 5, what is f(3)?
Choose the option that correctly completes the sentence:\n\nNeither the students nor the teacher ____ ready for the assembly.
questions.explanation: With “neither…nor,” the verb typically agrees with the noun closest to it. “Teacher” is singular, so “was” is correct.

questions.prompt: Choose the best transition to complete the sentence:\n\nThe team practiced every day; ____, it still felt unprepared for the tournament.
questions.explanation: The second clause contrasts with the first (they practiced, but still felt unprepared). “However” signals contrast.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence:\n\nThe scientist’s findings were ____; they challenged a long-held theory.
questions.explanation: If findings challenge a long-held theory, they are likely to provoke discussion or debate. “Provocative” fits that meaning.

questions.prompt: Choose the best way to combine the sentences:\n\nThe museum opened in 1920. It features modern art.
choices: The museum opened in 1920, and it features modern art.
The museum, opened in 1920 it features modern art.
The museum opened in 1920; featuring modern art.
Opened in 1920 the museum it features modern art.
questions.explanation: Choice A correctly combines two independent clauses using a comma + coordinating conjunction (and). The other options have grammatical issues.

questions.prompt: Choose the option that best maintains the sentence’s meaning and clarity:\n\nLina wanted to join the debate club. ____ she was nervous about public speaking, she attended the first meeting anyway.
questions.explanation: The second clause contrasts with her nervousness (she still attended). “Although” signals that contrast.

title: SAT Mini Practice Test 2 (Original)
description: Another set of 10 original practice questions (mixed sections).

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a solution to x² − 5x + 6 = 0?
questions.explanation: Factor: x² − 5x + 6 = (x − 2)(x − 3). Solutions are x = 2 or x = 3. So 2 is a solution.

questions.prompt: In a recipe, the ratio of flour to sugar is 3:2. If the recipe uses 10 cups of sugar, how many cups of flour does it use?
questions.explanation: If 2 parts sugar = 10 cups, then 1 part = 5 cups. Flour is 3 parts, so 3 × 5 = 15 cups.

questions.prompt: Simplify: 2³ · 2⁴
questions.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add exponents: 2³ · 2⁴ = 2^(3+4) = 2⁷.

questions.prompt: If g(x) = x² − 1, what is g(−3)?
A circle has radius 5. What is its circumference?
questions.explanation: Circumference C = 2πr. With r = 5, C = 2π(5) = 10π.

questions.prompt: Choose the option that correctly completes the sentence:\n\nEvery student must bring ____ laptop to class.
questions.explanation: “Every student” is singular, but modern English commonly uses singular “their” for clarity and inclusivity.

questions.prompt: Choose the best revision for concision and clarity:\n\nThe novel was popular among readers because it was interesting and had an exciting plot.
choices: The novel was popular among readers because it was interesting and had an exciting plot.
The novel was popular among readers because it had an exciting plot.
The novel, popular among readers, because exciting plot and interesting.
The novel was popular among readers, it had an exciting plot because interesting.
questions.explanation: Choice B removes redundancy: “interesting” overlaps with “exciting plot,” so keeping the stronger detail is clearer.

questions.prompt: Choose the option that best fixes parallel structure:\n\nThe workshop teaches participants to plan projects, managing time, and communicate clearly.
choices: The workshop teaches participants to plan projects, managing time, and communicate clearly.
The workshop teaches participants to plan projects, to manage time, and communicate clearly.
The workshop teaches participants to plan projects, manage time, and communicate clearly.
The workshop teaches participants to plan projects, manage time, and communicating clearly.
questions.explanation: Items in a list should match form. “Plan,” “manage,” and “communicate” are parallel verbs (choice C).

questions.prompt: Choose the best transition to complete the sentence:\n\nThe city expanded its bike lanes in 2023. ____, traffic congestion remained high.
questions.explanation: The second sentence contrasts with the first (expansion didn’t reduce congestion). “However” signals contrast.

questions.prompt: Choose the option that correctly completes the sentence:\n\nThe list of items on the desk ____ longer than expected.
questions.explanation: The subject is “list,” which is singular, so the correct verb is “seems.”
